vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you do every day

vocabulary.example: I have toast and cheese for breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: walk outside for pleasure or exercise
vocabulary.example: We go for a walk after dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: move your body to stay healthy
vocabulary.example: I exercise three times a week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place with machines for exercise
vocabulary.example: He goes to the gym after work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the work you do for money

vocabulary.note_ar: نقول make a call وليس do a call
vocabulary.note_en: Say "make a call", not "do a call".
vocabulary.example: She makes phone calls to customers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: keep your body healthy and strong
a place where you buy and eat meals
vocabulary.example: My uncle works in a restaurant.

vocabulary.meaning_en: go to shops to buy things
be with people or do something for some time
vocabulary.example: I spend time with my family on Friday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: take a long walk in nature
vocabulary.example: We go hiking in the mountains.

vocabulary.meaning_en: trees, plants, animals, mountains and the sea

fine_lines.title: do vs make
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نقول make phone calls و make dinner (نصنع شيئًا)، لكن do my homework و do exercise (نؤدي عملًا).
fine_lines.explanation_en: We say make a call / make dinner, but do homework / do exercise.

examples.sentence: I make phone calls at work.
I do my homework after school.

fine_lines.title: go + -ing activities
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع بعض الأنشطة نستخدم go + فعل بـ ing: go shopping, go hiking, go swimming. أما go for a walk فتأخذ for.
fine_lines.explanation_en: We say go + -ing for activities: go shopping, go hiking. But: go for a walk.

expressions.example: What is your daily routine? I wake up at six.

expressions.phrase: What do you do after breakfast?
expressions.meaning_en: Ask about the next part of the day.
expressions.example: What do you do after breakfast? I go to work.

expressions.phrase: What do you do at your job?
expressions.example: What do you do at your job? I help customers.

expressions.phrase: It is busy, but I like my job.
expressions.meaning_en: Say your job is busy but good.
expressions.example: It is busy, but I like my job.

expressions.phrase: Do you like teaching? — Yes, I love it!
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تحب التدريس؟ — نعم، أحبه كثيرًا!
expressions.example: Do you like cooking? Yes, I love it!
Hello! What are you talking about?

expressions.phrase: Do you go to the gym every day?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تذهب إلى الصالة الرياضية كل يوم؟
expressions.example: Do you go to the gym every day? Not every day.

expressions.phrase: What do you do on weekends?
expressions.meaning_ar: ماذا تفعل في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع؟
expressions.example: What do you do on weekends? I visit my parents.
We play football together. That sounds like fun!

grammar.title: Present simple: positive, negative, questions
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع البسيط للعادات. الإثبات: I wake up at 7. النفي: I do not (don't) exercise in the morning. السؤال: Do you go to the gym every day? / What do you do after work?
grammar.explanation_en: Present simple for habits. Positive: I wake up. Negative: I do not exercise. Question: Do you...? / What do you...?
examples: I do not exercise in the morning.
What do you do after work?

grammar.title: Time expressions: at, after, on
grammar.explanation_ar: at مع الساعة (at 8:30)، after مع حدث (after breakfast, after work)، on مع الأيام (on weekends).
grammar.explanation_en: Use at + clock time, after + an event, on + days.
examples: After breakfast, I take a shower.

grammar.title: Frequency: every day, sometimes, not every day
grammar.explanation_ar: every day = كل يوم، sometimes = أحيانًا، not every day = ليس كل يوم.
grammar.explanation_en: every day, sometimes, not every day show how often.
examples: I try to go every day.
Do you play games every day? Not every day.

questions.question: I ___ exercise in the morning. I go to the gym after work.
questions.explanation_ar: النفي مع I: do not + الفعل.
questions.explanation_en: Negative with I: do not + verb.

questions.question: I am a chef. I cook food for ___.
At work, I answer emails and ___ phone calls.
I go to the gym because I like to stay ___.
On weekends, I like to go ___.
questions.explanation_ar: go + فعل بـ ing: go hiking.

questions.question: Do you play games every day? — ___
questions.explanation_ar: الجواب المناسب عن التكرار: Not every day.
